title: Petrobras and the state monopoly of oil, 1953
summary: Law 2,004 of 3 October 1953, sanctioned by Getúlio Vargas, established the state monopoly of petroleum and created Petróleo Brasileiro S.A. It answered a draft Petroleum Statute of 1948 that would have opened the industry to private capital, at a time when world production was dominated by the Seven Sisters, five of them American; the campaign against it — *O petróleo é nosso*, "the oil is ours" — was the largest popular mobilisation of the period and is what carried the law. Brazil was producing 2,700 barrels a day in 1953. The company held the monopoly for over forty years, until Law 9,478 of 1997 opened the fields to competition.

actors.note: the state that took the monopoly and created the company to hold it
